g.title: workflow
g.text: Cell registration: from the MATLAB run to a query
amber = files and existing production tables · green = tables this change adds · blue = populated by make() · red = the one path that writes production
the schema is declared in code only; creating it and populating it are separate, explicitly authorised acts

g.text: 1 · plan the run, then BUILD its input from the curation

g.title: cluster_0

g.text: a bad file is recorded, not skipped
